changes.title: Democratic Senate Candidates in Maine Denounce Deadly ICE Shooting
changes.summary: The killing of a man in Biddeford quickly became an issue in the Senate race, with Democrats aiming to tie Senator Susan Collins to President Trump’s immigration crackdown.

changes.title: ICE Agent Kills Person in Vehicle in Biddeford, Maine, State Officials Say
changes.summary: The fatal shooting in Biddeford, Maine, was the second in a week involving an Immigration and Customs Enforcement agent firing into a vehicle.

changes.title: ICE-involved shooting leaves one person dead in Maine
changes.summary: The shooting happened Monday morning in Biddeford, Maine. The incident left one person dead. NBC News’ Erin McLaughlin has more.

changes.title: Morning news brief
changes.summary: Trump says the U.S. will collect tolls and impose blockade in the Strait of Hormuz, man killed by federal agents in Maine, states sue to stop Paramount-Warner Bros merger.

changes.title: Platner's voters are reeling as Maine Democratic Party races to choose his replacement
changes.summary: Graham Platner generated enthusiasm in Maine with his progressive policies. Now he's out of the race, and his supporters have to decide what's next, as Maine Democrats prepare to choose a nominee. (Image credit: Tamara Keith/NPR).

changes.title: Officials Investigate Fatal ICE Shooting in Maine as Fallout Grows
changes.summary: There is a growing demand for answers after a fatal ICE-involved shooting in Maine. According to an ICE spokesperson, the shooting happened when agents tried to conduct a traffic stop and, they say, the vehicle tried to get away.
